layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Hadrosaur crest morphology
features: A Parasaurolophus head with a long, iconic backward-curving clay crest
The crest has a smooth, solid clay texture with subtle decorative indentations
Soft green and teal clay skin with hand-pressed scale patterns along the neck and face
A warm, friendly expression with a large brown clay eye and a gentle smile
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic close-up profile shot of the Parasaurolophus. The lighting is warm and filtered, as if through a forest canopy, highlighting the smooth curves of the head crest. The background is a soft-focus prehistoric jungle. No text.
